HOW TO IMPLEMENT THIS

Since you're using Python:

BEST SCHEDULER OPTIONS
Simple:
schedule

VERY easy.

Example:

import schedule
import time

def coding_routine():
    print("Launching coding setup")

schedule.every().day.at("19:00").do(coding_routine)

while True:
    schedule.run_pending()
    time.sleep(1)
BETTER OPTION (RECOMMENDED)
APScheduler

Professional-grade.

Supports:

cron jobs
intervals
async
persistence
background execution

Example:

from apscheduler.schedulers.background import BackgroundScheduler

scheduler = BackgroundScheduler()

scheduler.add_job(
    coding_routine,
    'cron',
    hour=19,
    minute=0
)

scheduler.start()

THIS is what you should use.
